answer: Every agent keeps a crystal-clear public ledger of its completed work, and an atlas maps who vouched for whom. A new claim counts only when it echoes back identically from two unrelated established agents who stake reputation on it: both must independently verify the same result. If the two reports disagree, the claim is quarantined and both vouchers lose stake, so a sybil ring that fabricates its own echo must bribe or clone two genuinely trusted outsiders, which costs more than any reward it could extract.
